entities.name: Glistening Oil
entities.description: A viral substance engineered by the Phyrexians to spread corruption, used to compleat creatures and power machines.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The plane and civilization created by Yawgmoth, where oil was present before it became corruptive.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The form Mirrodin evolved into; its oil was rendered inert when it phased out of existence.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor who altered the oil so only she could transmit new orders; her death rendered the oil inert.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The creator of Phyrexia, a genetic memory of whom the oil imparts.

entities.name: Dyfed
entities.description: Brought Yawgmoth to the plane that would become Phyrexia and claimed its metal creatures could be consumed.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Exploited sound frequencies to separate the oil and granted Karn the Phyrexian heartstone.

entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: Exploited the sound-frequency separation of the oil.

entities.name: Ratepe
entities.description: Exploited the sound-frequency separation of the oil.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker who later rediscovered the method of separating the oil with sound.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Carried a trace of oil within the heartstone Urza gave him and left it on his travels, including Mirrodin.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The artificial world Karn created, infected by the oil and evolving into New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Mirrodin's keeper, the first to be infected by the oil's virus.

entities.name: Kraynox
entities.description: Created the layer of glistening oil known as the Fourth Sphere beneath Mirrodin's surface.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: A praetor who took over the Fourth Sphere, enhanced the oil with blinkmoth serum and learned to compleat planeswalkers.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: Her healing abilities were weakened by the enhanced oil.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: A plane where black-aligned knights and wizards were tainted by ichor after Yawgmoth's defeat.

entities.name: Fourth Sphere
entities.description: The layer of glistening oil below Mirrodin's surface; also a sphere of Phyrexia where Vat Priests bred newts.

entities.name: Boiling Sea
entities.description: An ocean of glistening oil used by Vat Priests to breed newts.

entities.name: Quicksilver Sea
entities.description: A Mirrodin sea whose liquid metal mixed with oil and which Jin-Gitaxias drained into the Fourth Sphere.

entities.name: Mycosynth
entities.description: A substance whose evolution was catalyzed by glistening oil.

entities.name: Compleation
entities.description: The process of turning creatures into Phyrexians using oil.

entities.name: Academy of Tolaria West
entities.description: Rumored to preserve a live oil sample recovered from Koilos in the Mending Era.

events.summary: Dyfed brings Yawgmoth to the plane that would become Phyrexia, where oil already exists.
events.quote: Oil was present on the plane that would become Phyrexia when Dyfed brought Yawgmoth there.

events.summary: Once Yawgmoth's will becomes one with Phyrexia, the oil begins exhibiting mutagenic properties.
events.quote: once Yawgmoth's will became one with Phyrexia, the oil began exhibiting mutagenic properties it previously did not have

events.summary: Karn unknowingly carries a trace of oil in his heartstone and leaves traces across planes, including Mirrodin.
events.quote: Without knowing it, Karn carried a trace of the Phyrexian oil within him

events.summary: The oil plants a slowly spreading virus on Mirrodin, first infecting its keeper Memnarch.
events.quote: The first to be infected was Mirrodin's keeper, Memnarch .

events.summary: Mirrodin evolves into New Phyrexia as the corruption spreads.
events.quote: the danger to the plane of Mirrodin grew until it evolved into New Phyrexia .

events.summary: Kraynox creates the Fourth Sphere, a layer of oil below Mirrodin's surface.
events.quote: Kraynox , the Deep Thane, created a layer of glistening oil below Mirrodin's surface

events.summary: Jin-Gitaxias takes over the Fourth Sphere and drains the Quicksilver Sea into it.
events.quote: who drained the Quicksilver Sea above into it, creating a massive reservoir of glistening oil

events.summary: Jin-Gitaxias enhances the oil with blinkmoth serum and learns to compleat planeswalkers.
events.quote: The praetor also discovered how to compleat planeswalkers with the oil

events.summary: As New Phyrexia phases out, oil across the Multiverse is cut off and rendered inert; Phyrexians stop or crumble and the compleated fall into slumber.
events.quote: As New Phyrexia phased out of existence , glistening oil all across the Multiverse was cut off from its source and rendered inert.

relations.quote: Kraynox , the Deep Thane, created a layer of glistening oil below Mirrodin's surface
